title: Cao Wei
capsule: Cao Wei was the northern state of the Three Kingdoms period, established in 220 AD when Cao Pi forced the abdication of the last Han emperor, building on the power base of his father Cao Cao. It was the most populous and powerful of the three kingdoms, with its capital at Luoyang. Real power passed to the Sima clan, who usurped the throne to found the Jin dynasty in 265 AD.
